For final S96 the full parent context is reused, including its dynamic-fourfold inner_seed and identities. Never pass unsupported sizes.

forecast_diagnostic_design_review.target: At genuine held-out C annual calendar years, compare annual asset logreturn relative to bills against same-calendar joint training fan, using only training market paths and no actual future for prediction.
forecast_diagnostic_design_review.dependence: Within-scenario years and repeated train/eval partitions are dependent. Aggregate each complete path first when comparing forecast error; report year/asset structure without pretending thousands of forecast rows are IID.
forecast_diagnostic_design_review.estimand: This audits the declared same-calendar unconditional marginal forecast. One held-out realized future per state is not a known true conditional distribution or proof of conditional calibration/miscalibration.
forecast_diagnostic_design_review.joint_and_tail: Marginal relative-return intervals or PIT/ranks cannot validate joint cross-asset dependence, tail dependence, history-conditioned probabilities, or lifetime everbreach conditional Q.
forecast_diagnostic_design_review.scoring: Use predeclared finite empirical proper score such as CRPS plus mean forecast error and interval/rank summaries; explicit finite-rank/tie convention. Do not choose score/bandwidth/fan source/calendar pooling after looking at outcomes.
forecast_diagnostic_design_review.relative_bills: Relative nominal logreturn to bills cancels common CPI; cannot by itself certify real-purchasing-power or bill reserve safety.
forecast_diagnostic_design_review.actual_policy: Do not reconstruct an implementable oracle strategy from realized branch suffixes. Saved current-hold/restore-plus-B diagnostic is explanatory and is not forecast of adaptive future policy.
forecast_diagnostic_design_review.possible_interpretation: A finding that same-calendar marginal distributions vary by split or calendar year supports caution about forecast stability. It does not uniquely attribute controller risk to a forecast error versus target/state/selection changes.

preexecution_checklist: Freeze all25outer contexts/125jobs and exact seeds/IDs before any new market fit.
Validate every training/evaluation disjointness/complement/size and each scenario once per repeat.
Final S96 static calibration context must equal parent dynamic4fold context including seed and folds; separate final-static seed would change the frozen learning algorithm.
Source/hash identity equals frozen joint learner; import helpers rather than monkeypatching old modules.
Synthetic all-case tests include Q1 Review and outsideBalanced, emptyE, allErefitfail, distinct selected prices and duplicate selected orders.
Compute repeated structure even when every actualnewfit happens to be Balanced; do not omit dormant NULL branches.
Independent summary/selection/partition audit then bounded independent financial/Q replay; no probability certification.
No oldold or new source/results changed after freeze; preserve implementation failure artifact before any repair.
Do not count repeated reference outcomes or deduplicated price arms as independent observations.
acceptance_limits: Resampling from120 already reused scenarios cannot restore unseen-data status. Historical V1 final121–180 was seen; never parse those rows in this stage.
No claim of award, deployment safety, identified risk preference, population coverage or guaranteed10% exceedance.
A stable selector may repeatedly make a poor forecast; an unstable selected parameter may still induce identical actions. Report both selection and decision/outcome stability.
